title: [Workspaces] Cannot uncheck "Launch as administrator" for a captured Win32 app when the checkbox is disabled

judgment.rationale: The binding explains the checked-but-disabled state. A narrow allow-clear transition is plausible, but must preserve restrictions on enabling unsupported elevation and avoid changing token/UAC policy.
evidence: The report supplies is-elevated:true/can-launch-elevated:false, a screenshot, an asInvoker Win32 app and a missing AppsFolder entry.
WorkspacesEditorPage binds IsChecked to IsElevated and IsEnabled solely to CanLaunchElevated.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/Workspaces/WorkspacesEditor/WorkspacesEditorPage.xaml: Launch-as-admin checkbox IsEnabled is CanLaunchElevated while IsChecked is the independently captured IsElevated.
Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/Workspaces/WorkspacesEditor/Models/Application.cs: IsElevated and CanLaunchElevated are distinct model properties.

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. The problematic binding is explicit, but the complete editor/model notification and launcher behavior need focused validation.

proposed_fixes.title: Allow clearing an existing elevation request
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A capability-only IsEnabled binding conflates permission to enable elevation with the ability to remove an already captured request.
plan: Confirm the true/false model combination in the editor.
Define a state transition that permits clearing IsElevated even when CanLaunchElevated is false, while blocking a new unsupported true value.
Test all four state combinations and persisted normal-launch behavior.
verification: Checked/unsupported can be cleared; unchecked/unsupported cannot be newly enabled.
No UAC/signature policy or supported elevation behavior is bypassed.
